test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The movie was so boring that I fell ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**asleep**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**asleep**" is an adjective that means "in a state of sleep."
 
• In the sentence, "fell" is the correct verb to indicate a transition into a state, and it is followed by the adjective "**asleep**" to complete the meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The movie was so boring that I fell **asleep**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "slept"** cannot follow "fell" because "slept" is a past tense verb, and "fell" requires an adjective to describe the state.
 
• **Option 2: "sleep"** is incorrect because the base form of the verb does not fit contextually or grammatically.
 
• **Option 4: "sleeping"** is incorrect because "fell sleeping" is not a valid construction in English.
